exposure: Increasing rates and levels of obesity
cohort: The study included 88 pregnant women requiring peripartum admission to the intensive care unit out of 1726 deliveries over a 1-year period at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The rate of ICU admission was 5.09%, with severe pre-eclampsia, post-partum hemorrhage, and eclampsia being the most common diagnoses at admission, and maternal mortality during the study period was 5.6%.
